episodes.187103: A band of precipitation, with embedded heavy rain showers and isolated thunderstorms moved across the South Carolina Piedmont in association with an area of low pressure and attendant cold front. One of the storms produced a very brief and very weak tornado in southwest Chester County.
episodes.187112: A line of showers in advance of a cold front produced gusty winds across portions of the James River.
episodes.187284: A cold front swept eastwards across the Mid Atlantic and Southeast on the morning of November 22nd. Out ahead and along this eastward moving cold front, widespread rain and thunderstorm activity was noted with a few of these storms becoming strong to severe in nature. The strongest of these storms brought strong winds, frequent lightning, and heavy rain to the Pamlico/Pungo Rivers, Pamlico Sound and the coastal waters south of Cape Hatteras.

events.narrative: NWS storm survey found the path of a very brief and weak tornado that touched down along Breeland Dr just off Leeds Rd. Damage consisted of a few downed large tree limbs and one split tree. Path length was estimated due to inaccessibility beyond Breeland Dr.
